summary: Each supplied edition was reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Latin working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the garment–spirit comparison, rhetorical negations, punishment, speaker changes, mercy, and beneficial repentance without adding doctrinal conditions. The simplified edition’s shorter sentences retain the substantive assertions. The notes distinguish editorial supplementation from manuscript attestation and accurately disclose the relevant supplied apparatus reports without replacing the working readings or claiming fresh manuscript verification. Acceptance is limited to these supplied texts and attributed reports; it is not certification of unseen editions, images, or exhaustive collation.
